contracts: none: package.json pins no openvibe-contracts (openvibe-shared v1.23.0 only)
deployment: Deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy sites --restart` (OpenVibe.Host strategy static-build since the 2026-09-27 cutover): /opt/openvibe.sites, nginx serves dist/<domain>/ through deploy/nginx/<domain>.conf; no unit, no port, no env file
features: one catalog and one template for every placeholder and notice page
labels built from facts.json (each repository's STATUS.json and Network's registry), never a hand-kept list
the pinned OpenVibe Frame served from dist/_shared/
full SEO: canonical, Open Graph, Twitter, JSON-LD, robots, sitemap, manifest
a release.json per domain and host.release.published on deploy
